rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses (incl. home study) sponsored or approved by ADA/ADHA and affiliates, Academy of General Dentistry, National Dental Association, CODA-accredited schools of dentistry/dental hygiene, recognized specialty associations, VA and Armed Forces dental departments, Georgia DPH, AMA/NMA and affiliates, JCAHO-accredited hospitals
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE applies within the first biennium of Georgia licensure; a new dentist may instead show CODA-accredited dental coursework from the previous two years.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; hours must be earned in the biennium they are applied to.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; send official documentation within 30 days of the audit letter. Keep records 3 years after the biennium ends.

topics.who: Infection control in dental practice incl. dental unit water lines (since 2024)
Opioid abuse, proper prescription writing and/or opioid use in dental practice
Current CPR at all times; in-person CPR/BLS/ACLS course earns 4 h

rules.notes: At least 30 h clinical and at least 20 h in person (not online/journal). Max 12 h per day. Current CPR certification required at all times (Rule 150-3-.08); an in-person CPR/BLS/ACLS course earns 4 h. Limited credit for teaching, charity care, board service.
